description: Creates a tracking link and returns its shareable URL. A tap is logged as a click, then redirected to destination_url with the click's id, which is how an install is credited to the link. Use the store address for a real campaign, or the app's own scheme (myapp://) for a link that opens the app in a test. Creates a new link each time; nothing existing changes. Needs read and edit access.

deep_link_value.description: Where in the app to send the person

destination_url.description: Where a tap goes: a store address, a web page or myapp://

name.description: What the link is for, shown on the Links page

play_store_url.description: Google Play address, for the install referrer

provider.description: Media source in lowercase, like tiktok

slug.description: Vanity slug, 3 to 50 letters and digits. Leave out for a random one.

name: create_tracking_link
title: Create a tracking link
